senses.definition: n.pr.loc. (vigorous, for אונון) city in Benjamin Ezr 2:33; Ne 7:37; 11:35; 1 Ch 8:12; valley of same name Ne 6:2; prob. Kefr ʿAnâ, NW. of Lydda, SurveyII, 251.
